verdict.rationale: Otter documents a way to keep an organization's data out of AI model training, but only on the Enterprise tier and only by contacting an account manager (otter-docs-43). A community report notes that by default recordings are retained and used, anonymized, as training data (otter-comm-6). That fits an enterprise-only opt-out and does not contradict the claim, but it confirms individual and non-enterprise users get no documented control. Missing for 10: a self-serve opt-out for individual or non-enterprise users, detailed docs on scope and enforcement of the exclusion, and independent confirmation that the exclusion works.
